offers_products.reason: Makes NARCAN nasal spray, CYFENDUS and BioThrax anthrax vaccines, smallpox vaccine, antitoxins sold as main products.

offers_services.reason: Contract development and manufacturing (bioservices) for biopharma, governments and NGOs is a named offering, though smaller than products.

big_ticket.reason: Nasal spray doses and vaccines are small unit sales, though government stockpile contracts can be large.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured vaccines, antitoxins and naloxone devices, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main revenue comes from the US government (BARDA, military) and other governments buying countermeasures.

notes: Recurring revenue is a judgement call: government contract orders recur but are lumpy.
